items.title: Resend site now renders as Markdown for AI Agents
items.summary: Resend announced that its entire site, including blogs and documentation, now renders as Markdown specifically to support AI agents.

items.title: CopilotKit raises $27M to help devs deploy app-native AI agents
items.summary: CopilotKit secured $27M in funding to assist developers in deploying app-native AI agents using their framework.

items.title: AI research lab NeoCognition lands $40M seed to build agents that learn like humans
items.summary: NeoCognition raised a $40M seed round to develop AI agents capable of human-like learning to become experts across various domains.
